item.title: Perill biològic
item.description:
Adrià Mitjavila on February 10, 2021

The Perill Biologic blog is unmantained, but its old posts are listed in this site with the tag “Perill Biologic”. If I create any new outreach post, I will include this tag too.

I have recently started a blog named Perill Biològic.

The blog is entirely in catalan and is focussed to communicate general Biology knowledge to society.

item.title: BioBit
item.description:
Adrià Mitjavila on November 20, 2020

The BioBit blog has been closed, but its old posts are listed in this site with the tag “Biobit”. If I create any new outreach post, I will include this tag too.

[BioBit](https://biobit.netlify.app) is a blog dedicated to spread and communicate bioinformatics to society. I made it using the R package `distill` and to publish it I used Netlify, because GitHub pages force me to have it as a subdomain of my personal website.
